Name the quantity on the growth-rate axis of the Incucyte analysis

Source: R/incucyte_utils.R
rate_axis_label.Rd

The bar panel plots plot_value, which is a normalized rate where is_normalized is TRUE and a raw one where it is FALSE. Periods are faceted and normalization_map gives each period one target, so the flag is constant within a facet and the two kinds only meet when a config mixes "None" with a reference period. In every other case the axis names one quantity, and saying so beats naming both.

Usage

rate_axis_label(is_normalized, metric = c("NormalizedGrowthRate", "GR"))

Arguments

is_normalized

logical; one value per plotted row, as the analysis derives it from normalization_map. Only the distinct values matter.

metric

string; the configured growth_metric, which decides how a normalized rate is named.

Value

A string for ggplot2::ylab().

Examples

rate_axis_label(c(TRUE, TRUE), "GR")
#> [1] "GR value"
rate_axis_label(c(FALSE, FALSE), "GR")
#> [1] "Raw log2 growth rate"
rate_axis_label(c(TRUE, FALSE), "GR")
#> [1] "GR value or raw log2 growth rate"
